title: Federated Learning
description: Federated learning: Privacy-preserving distributed ML. Train on decentralized data (mobile, hospital). FedAvg, secure aggregation, differential privacy. No raw data sharing.

content.level0_basic: Federated Learning: Data stays on devices (phones, hospitals), train model collaboratively. Server aggregates model updates (not raw data). Privacy-preserving. Example: Google Gboard (keyboard predictions, millions of phones), hospitals (patient data never leaves). FedAvg algorithm: (1) Server sends global model, (2) Devices train locally, (3) Send gradients/weights to server, (4) Server averages → new global model. Benefits: Privacy (GDPR, HIPAA), large-scale (billions of devices), data quality (diverse, real-world).
content.level1_beginner: FL variants: (1) Cross-device FL (millions of phones, Google, Apple), (2) Cross-silo FL (hospitals, banks, few participants). Challenges: (1) Non-IID data (each device different distribution), (2) Communication cost (bandwidth limited, compression), (3) Stragglers (slow devices, dropout), (4) Privacy attacks (gradient leakage). Solutions: FedProx (handle heterogeneity), secure aggregation (encrypted updates), differential privacy (noise addition). Communication: Gradient compression (top-k, quantization), model compression (distillation). Frameworks: TensorFlow Federated, PySyft, Flower, FedML.
content.level2_application: Applications: (1) Mobile keyboards (Gboard, SwiftKey), (2) Healthcare (hospital collaboration, rare diseases), (3) Finance (fraud detection, banks), (4) IoT (smart home, edge devices). Deployment: On-device training (TFLite, CoreML), server aggregation (secure MPC), differential privacy (ε-DP). Production: Google, Apple (privacy by design), NVIDIA Clara (healthcare FL). Cross-silo: 10-100 organizations (hospitals, banks). Privacy tech: Homomorphic encryption, secure multi-party computation.
content.level3_advanced: Advanced: (1) Personalization (local fine-tuning + global model), (2) Asynchronous FL (no sync wait), (3) Hierarchical FL (edge-cloud), (4) Incentive mechanisms (contribution reward), (5) Fairness (underrepresented groups), (6) Robustness (Byzantine attacks, poisoning). Research: Split learning, vertical FL (different features), transfer FL, continual FL (lifelong learning).
content.level4_expert: Production systems: Model versioning, client selection (biased sampling), convergence guarantees (non-convex), communication-efficient protocols, privacy auditing (membership inference defense), regulatory compliance (GDPR Article 25). Hardware: Edge TPU, secure enclaves (TEE). Scale: 10M+ devices. Research frontiers: Zero-knowledge FL, blockchain-based FL, quantum-secure FL.

formulas: \text{FedAvg}: \quad w_{t+1} = \sum_{k=1}^K \frac{n_k}{n} w_k^t \quad \text{(weighted average of client models)}
\text{Differential Privacy}: \quad \mathcal{M}(D) \text{ is } (\epsilon, \delta)\text{-DP if } P(\mathcal{M}(D) \in S) \leq e^\epsilon P(\mathcal{M}(D') \in S) + \delta
\text{Communication Cost}: \quad C = R \cdot K \cdot |w| \quad \text{(R=rounds, K=clients, |w|=model size)}
